natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: I intend to simplify onboarding because current onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests this improves time-to-value and first-week activation. I would avoid deep promotional pricing because it may boost signups while harming renewal quality. The experiment should include guardrails for qualified conversion, retention, and downstream revenue so completion gains do not come at the expense of durable value.
